5718.title: Native timeline paging ignores an overlapping footer
5718.rootCauseOneLine: The sticky composer obscures the scrollport without reserving native scroll padding, so keyboard page steps exceed the visible transcript region.
5718.proposedFix: Keep native scroll-padding-bottom synchronized with the sticky footer height, including resize and removal.
5718.caveats: The same agent repeated the exact production component reproduction in a second clean trusted checkout; no full provider session or other browser engines were tested. Reproduction code and output are inline to honor reports repository policy.
